content: Cloudflare post-mortem (2017-01-01 leap second): Go production service (RRDNS) assumed time differences are never negative; when the leap second made time.Now() go backwards, negative RTT values flowed into rand.Int63n() and panicked DNS resolution fleet-wide. Root cause: 'time cannot go backwards' falsehood; fix: detect negative deltas and reset state. Directly applicable to Snowflake generators whose timestamps come from the wall clock.
